items.title: Regulatory Body
items.description: IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India) regulates the insurance sector in India, established in 1999.

items.title: Free Look Period
items.description: A policyholder has 15 days (30 days for electronic policies) to review and cancel the policy for a full refund if unsatisfied.

items.title: Grace Period
items.description: A grace period of 30 days is allowed for yearly, half-yearly, and quarterly premiums, and 15 days for monthly premiums.

items.title: Nomination vs Assignment
items.description: Nomination transfers only the right to receive money upon death, while Assignment transfers the ownership of the policy entirely.

items.title: Minimum Age
items.description: The minimum age for taking a standard life insurance policy in India is 18 years (majority age).
